title.en: Control-response loss and recovery through retained joint relations
title.zh: 控制响应丧失与保留共同关系的恢复

claim.zh: 对每个约化与观测：观测经约化读出的是单值，恰在观测于约化所合并者之间相同之处；在约化合并的两个构型上，在两处都对的解码器存在恰当观测在那里一致，所以没有映射能恢复它合并的两个不同构型。在明示实振幅片段中，受控 X/Z 次序与完全退相干保留控制分支权重但改变固定测量响应；对角线合并加号响应不同的相干与退化矩阵，故仅凭对角线的解码失败；退相干合并制备与相干矩阵，故没有统一逆映射：两者都是实例。与空白寄存器的可逆交互经约化恰好实现退相干；保留共同状态允许精确反转。
claim.en: For every reduction and observable: what the observable reads through the reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges; on two configurations the reduction merges, a decoder right at both exists exactly when the observable agrees there, so no map restores two different configurations it merges. In the specified real-amplitude fragment, controlled X/Z order and complete dephasing preserve control branch weights while changing a fixed measurement response; the diagonal merges the coherent and degraded matrices, whose plus responses differ, so a diagonal-only decoder fails, and dephasing merges the prepared and coherent matrices, so no uniform inverse exists: both are instances. A reversible interaction with a blank register realizes the dephasing on reduction, and retaining the joint state permits exact reversal.

hypotheses.en: Integer amplitude and density numerators with explicit normalization; H, X, Z, coherent control, reduction and measurement are specified operations, not derived physical laws. Arbitrary integer matrices are not asserted to be physical states.
hypotheses.zh: 整数振幅及密度分子具有公开归一化；H、X、Z、相干控制、约化及测量均为明示操作，不是推导出的物理定律。不声称任意整数矩阵均为物理状态。

hypotheses.en: The no-inverse result requires one map to restore both original preparations from their common reduced output alone. Joint reversal retains the initially blank register and control of the same joint operation.
hypotheses.zh: 无逆映射结果要求同一映射仅凭共同约化输出恢复两种原制备；共同反转保留最初空白寄存器及对同一共同操作的控制。

correspondence.en: A restricted algebraic instantiation of standard quantum operations with the control coordinate first. Matrix traces and shared response denominators are explicit. This is a state-interface calculation, not a verified implementation of the full higher-order switch or a laboratory run.
correspondence.zh: 标准量子操作的受限代数实例化，以控制坐标为先；矩阵迹和响应共同分母公开。这是状态接口计算，不是完整高阶开关的已验证实现或实验运行。

detail.en: Extends the operative comparison beyond existential context support; the prior trace theorem is neither imported nor claimed to represent quantum coherence.
detail.zh: 将作用比较推进到存在性情境支持之外；未导入此前历史定理，也不声称它已表示量子相干性。

detail.en: Contrasts loss at a reduced interface with recovery at a retained joint interface; no formal transport to that fixed-law endpoint theorem is claimed.
detail.zh: 比较约化接口的损失与保留共同接口的恢复；不声称已形式接入固定规律端点定理。

detail.en: The prepared, coherent and degraded matrices share diagonal (1,1) but have distinct plus responses. Prepared and coherent matrices dephase to the same matrix, blocking uniform recovery from that matrix alone.
detail.zh: 已制备、相干与退化矩阵共享对角线(1,1)，但正向响应不同；前两者退相干至同一矩阵，阻断仅凭该矩阵的统一恢复。

limitations.en: The checked fragment has real integer amplitudes, selected operations and one response. It proves neither causal nonseparability, arbitrary complex quantum behavior, physical implementation, universal irreversibility, ethical degeneration nor the universal zero-substantive-axiom foundation.
limitations.zh: 所查片段限于实整数振幅、选定操作及一种响应。未证明因果不可分离、任意复数量子行为、物理实现、普遍不可逆、伦理退化或普遍零实质公理根基。

validation_scope.en: Fresh Lean 4.29.1 build: 27 theorems and 54 declaration audits. 44 reports empty; 10 use propext, three of those also Quot.sound. No custom postulates or final Classical.choice. Source-bound frozen receipt; author counterreview, no independent acceptance or new empirical result.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1重新实编27项定理及54项声明审计。44项空，10项含propext，其中3项另含Quot.sound；无自定公理或最终Classical.choice。回执绑定冻结源码；作者反审，无独立验收或新增经验成果。

next_delta.en: Use the established difference between local access and retained joint relations in the common constitutive argument. Warrant the universal claim at its full scope instead of promoting this supplied quantum mechanism into universal ontology.
next_delta.zh: 将局部可用与保留共同关系的已建立区别用于共同构成论证；取得普遍主张完整范围的根据，不把给定量子机制升格为普遍本体。
